anastasia-beverly-hills-brow-wiz.text: A retractable brow pencil with an ultra-fine 1 mm tip for drawing individual hair-like strokes into sparse areas. The waxy formula holds colour well, and the spoolie on the other end softens everything into a natural finish. Comes in 11 shades.

beautyblender-original-makeup-sponge.text: The original teardrop-shaped makeup sponge. The soft, latex-free foam blends foundation, concealer and cream products into a skin-like finish quickly, used damp for the sheerest result.

ma-nyo-pure-cleansing-oil.text: A plant-oil cleanser that dissolves makeup, sunscreen and the gunk in pores, then turns milky when it meets water and rinses clean. Gentle enough for morning and evening use, and suitable for all skin types, acne-prone included.

star.name: Soybean oil
star.does: Main cleansing oil — lifts makeup and sebum without stripping

star.name: Hazelnut and grape seed oils
star.does: Light oils that help loosen blackheads and whiteheads

star.name: Squalane
star.does: Leaves skin soft rather than tight after rinsing

mac-cosmetics-lip-pencil.text: M·A·C's classic lip liner: creamy enough to glide on without skipping, firm enough to shape a precise line. Use it to define, fill in the whole lip, or slightly overline for a fuller look. Comes in 35 shades, including the best-selling Oak, Whirl, Soar, Chestnut and Spice.

makeup-by-mario-master-mattes-eyeshadow-.text: Twelve matte neutral shadows chosen to work across every skin tone. The texture is creamy and buildable rather than chalky, so shades blend out softly for anything from a wash of colour to a defined crease.

makeup-by-mario-softsculpt-transforming-.text: A cream bronzer that warms the complexion, sculpts and evens skin tone in one step. Coverage is light to medium and it dries down to a dewy finish, so it reads as skin rather than powder.

rare-beauty-positive-light-silky-touch-h.text: A finely milled powder highlighter that gives a glassy, natural-looking sheen rather than visible glitter. It builds easily and is made to last through the day.

rare-beauty-soft-pinch-liquid-blush.text: A weightless liquid blush where one dot is enough for a whole cheek. It blends out seamlessly into a natural flush and is made to last up to 12 hours.

sol-de-janeiro-brazilian-bum-bum-cream.text: A fast-absorbing body cream aimed at smoother, firmer-looking skin, including the look of cellulite. It hydrates and locks in moisture, and carries Sol de Janeiro's signature salted caramel and pistachio scent, Cheirosa 62.

star.name: Guaraná extract
star.does: Caffeine-rich extract used to visibly tighten and firm

star.name: Cupuaçu butter
star.does: Deeply moisturises and helps hold in hydration

star.name: Squalane
star.does: Lightweight emollient that leaves skin smooth and glowy

supergoop-unseen-sunscreen-spf-50.text: A clear, scent-free SPF 50 that leaves no white cast and feels weightless on the skin. It sits smoothly enough to double as a makeup primer, and the latest formula is clinically tested to improve skin clarity.

star.name: Shea butter
star.does: Softens and helps keep skin from drying out

star.name: Sea algae extract
star.does: Brown seaweed extract that adds antioxidant support

star.name: Bisabolol
star.does: Calms skin and helps reduce the look of redness

tangle-teezer-the-ultimate-detangler-ext.text: A detangling brush built for fragile hair or hair that sheds easily. The teeth are spaced wider than usual, with fewer at the edges to reduce tension, so knots come out with less pulling and breakage. Keep it away from heat.

tree-hut-moroccan-rose-shea-sugar-scrub.text: A sugar body scrub that buffs away dull, dry skin in the shower and leaves it soft and glowing, scented with Moroccan rose. The sugar is suspended in shea butter and a blend of plant oils, so skin feels moisturised rather than stripped afterwards.

star.does: Physical exfoliant that polishes away dry, flaky skin
